tools.name: lokalapi_info
tools.description: Free. Explains the paid tools, prices and how an agent pays per call via x402 (USDC on Base). Call this first.

tools.name: wilayah_search
tools.description: Search official Indonesian administrative regions (province, regency/city, district, village) by name and get the official Kemendagri 2025 code plus full hierarchy. Handles 'Kab.', 'Kota', 'Kec.' prefixes. Costs $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base; see lokalapi_info).

tools.name: wilayah_get
tools.description: Resolve an official Indonesian region code (Kemendagri 2025, e.g. '34.71' or '34.04.12.2001') to its name, type and full administrative hierarchy. Costs $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; see lokalapi_info).

tools.name: kbli_search
tools.description: Find the right KBLI 2025 business classification code (5-digit, mandatory in Indonesia's OSS business licensing since 15 June 2026) from a free-text business activity in Indonesian or English. Returns official BPS titles, descriptions and hierarchy. Costs $0.02 per call (x402, USDC on Base; see loka

tools.name: kbli_convert
tools.description: Convert a KBLI 2020 business code to its KBLI 2025 equivalent(s) using the official BPS conversion table (2026). Flags one-to-many splits. Needed to update OSS/NIB licences after the June 2026 switch. Costs $0.02 per call (x402, USDC on Base; see lokalapi_info).

tools.name: kbli_convert_batch
tools.description: Convert up to 50 KBLI 2020 business codes to KBLI 2025 in one call (official BPS conversion table, 2026), e.g. all codes of a company's OSS/NIB licence. Per code: status one_to_one, split, merged, not_found or invalid, the KBLI 2025 candidates, and needs_review with the reason; plus a summary. forma
